aboutGame.title: What is Pokemon Uranium?
paragraphs: Pokemon Uranium is a free fan-made monster-catching RPG set in the original Tandor region. Built over roughly nine years by a volunteer team and released in August 2016, it ships with more than 150 original Pokemon, a full eight-gym challenge, and its own signature Nuclear type that no official game has ever used.

You travel Tandor collecting gym badges, catching and evolving a custom Pokedex of Fakemon, and building a team around type matchups the mainline games never taught you. Our wiki covers the walkthrough, starters, evolution levels, gym leaders, tier list, and post-game so you can plan every step of the run.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Pokemon Uranium.

items.question: What is Pokemon Uranium?
items.answer: Pokemon Uranium is a free fan-made monster-catching RPG set in the original Tandor region. It launched in August 2016 after roughly nine years of volunteer development and features more than 150 original Pokemon, eight gyms, and the series-first Nuclear type.

items.question: Is Pokemon Uranium free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Pokemon Uranium is a free fan project for Windows PC. It is not an official Nintendo, Game Freak, or The Pokemon Company release, and this wiki is an independent guide site built by players.

items.question: Which Pokemon Uranium starter should I pick?
items.answer: Pokemon Uranium gives you three dual-typed starters: Orchynx, Raptorch, and Eletux. Orchynx is the bulky Grass / Steel tank, Raptorch is the fast Fire / Ground sweeper, and Eletux is the balanced Water / Electric special attacker, so pick the role your team needs most.

items.question: How many gyms are in Pokemon Uranium?
items.answer: Pokemon Uranium has eight gyms in the Tandor League. You need all eight badges to enter the Tandor Championship, and each badge also raises the level at which traded Pokemon will obey you.

items.question: What is the Nuclear type in Pokemon Uranium?
items.answer: Nuclear is Pokemon Uranium's signature type. It is super effective against 17 of the 19 types in the game, but it is also the weakest defensive type, taking double damage from 18 types and resisting only itself.
